description: Source code for a dynamically quantized sparse linear module with support for sparse quantization, including class definition, methods for weight/bias setting, serialization, and conversion from float modules.

classes.name: Linear
classes.description: A dynamically quantized sparse linear module supporting sparse quantization and conversion from float modules.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the sparse dynamic linear module with specified features, block sizes, bias, and dtype.

methods.name: _get_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the module.

methods.name: extra_repr
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the module's configuration.

methods.name: __repr__
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the module, hiding packed params.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs the forward pass using sparse quantized dynamic linear operation.

methods.name: _save_to_state_dict
methods.description: Saves the module's state, including op_type.

methods.name: _load_from_state_dict
methods.description: Loads the module's state, verifying op_type and version, and restoring weights and biases.
